vehicles.title: Mitsubishi Outlander
vehicles.tagline: Elevate Every Drive with Supreme Comfort and Capability
vehicles.hero_headline: Next-Generation 7-Seater Luxury SUV with Super All-Wheel Control
vehicles.overview: The 2026 Mitsubishi Outlander is engineered for discerning drivers who demand commanding performance, cutting-edge technology, and sophisticated 3-row comfort. Equipped with Mitsubishi's rally-proven Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) and premium interior appointments, the Outlander redefines modern adventure.

vehicles.title: Mitsubishi Eclipse Cross
vehicles.tagline: Sculpted for the Bold, Driven by Turbocharged Innovation
vehicles.hero_headline: Dynamic Turbocharged Coupe SUV Built to Turn Heads
vehicles.overview: With its sleek coupe silhouette, muscular arches, and responsive turbocharged powertrain, the 2026 Mitsubishi Eclipse Cross combines sporty driving dynamics with versatile crossover practicality. Whether navigating city streets or cruising coastal roads, the Eclipse Cross delivers poised agility and unmistakable presence.

vehicles.title: Mitsubishi L200
vehicles.tagline: Engineered Beyond Toughness, Built for Trinidad's Toughest Challenges
vehicles.hero_headline: Next-Gen 4x4 Double Cab Pickup with Unmatched Durability and Power
vehicles.overview: The all-new 2026 Mitsubishi L200 Triton is the definitive double cab pickup, fusing rugged heavy-duty chassis engineering with refined passenger comfort. Featuring Mitsubishi's advanced Super Select 4WD-II, high-output turbo diesel power, and a reinforced 1-tonne cargo bed with 3.5-tonne towing capacity, the L200 masters construction sites, estates, and city highways alike.

vehicles.title: Mitsubishi ASX
vehicles.tagline: Compact Agility, Maximum Versatility for the Urban Adventurer
vehicles.hero_headline: Smart, Sleek, and Fuel-Efficient Compact Crossover
vehicles.overview: Designed for the urban pulse and weekend getaways, the 2026 Mitsubishi ASX combines athletic styling with robust Japanese engineering. Its compact footprint makes city parking effortless, while the elevated seating position and responsive MIVEC engine ensure commanding road visibility and engaging performance.

vehicles.title: Mitsubishi Xpander
vehicles.tagline: Room for Everything, Built for Family Journeys
vehicles.overview: The 2026 Mitsubishi Xpander is Trinidad and Tobago's ultimate multi-purpose family vehicle, pairing a commanding 205-225mm ground clearance with genuine 7-passenger capability. Offering car-like driving dynamics, exceptional fuel economy, and unmatched interior flexibility, the Xpander transforms every family road trip into first-class comfort.
